title: Kaczogród SMP
description: Simple modpack made to be base for SMPs servers.
body:
# Purpose
The purpose of this pack is to make running simple SMPs easier, for people with no experience. 

# What it cointains
- Plasmo Voice
- Talking Heads
- Distant Horizons
- Locator Heads

# IMPORTANT
To make Distant Horizons and Simple Voice Chat work u need to have them installed server-side. There is [Distant Horizons Support Plugin](https://modrinth.com/plugin/distant-horizons-support) that allows for having Distant Horizons working on unmodded servers.

If u want to make sculk sensors and warden reactive to Plasmo Voice, u need to have installed [pv-addon-sculk]([https://modrinth.com/plugin/distant-horizons-support](https://modrinth.com/plugin/pv-addon-sculk)) on the server side.
